description:
Discover elevated city living in Bristol’s newest build-to-rent community — 374 contemporary apartments across three striking blocks, soaring up to the 18th floor.

Glasshouse Square is a pet-friendly, safe, and secure building in the heart of Bristol, with a dedicated on-site resident services team. Contemporary apartments feature bright, open-plan living, kitchen, and dining spaces, stunning city views, and access to exceptional facilities included for effortless, modern city living.

Reserve now and move in by October 2026 to receive 1 months free rent!

Experience elevated city living in Bristol’s newest build-to-rent community — a stunning collection of 374 contemporary apartments spread across three blocks, reaching up to the 18th floor.

This pet-friendly* development offers thoughtfully designed apartments, most with private balconies or terraces boasting incredible views across Bristol.

Enjoy seamless connectivity with ultrafast Wi-Fi included, and make the most of an exceptional range of residents’ amenities:

· Two panoramic roof terraces on the 7th and 10th floors

· Stylish residents’ lounge

· 24/7 gym and dedicated yoga studio

· Games room and bookable private dining space

· Beautiful podium terrace gardens for relaxation and socialising

With an on-site resident services team available to assist your renting needs, this is modern renting redefined — designed for comfort, community, and convenience.

Reserve your apartment today and be among the first to call this landmark Bristol address home.

Please note: images shown are stock images and may not reflect the exact apartment layout or view.

*Subject to contract, pet license and T&C’s 

**Incentive T&C’s apply, subject to contract.
